asked.item: date for First Comment on LinkedIn
whether First Comment is available on LinkedIn

verdict.reason: The help pages state directly that First Comment is not supported for LinkedIn and give no release date for the blocking LinkedIn API access.

steps.text: First Comment is not available for LinkedIn in Blotato.
LinkedIn restricts access to the comment and messaging API endpoints Blotato needs, and Blotato is seeking approved API access with no release date.
First Comment works on Instagram and Facebook posts.
